topic: Blackbeard's Devil Fruit hunting, his Impel Down and former-Warlord recruiting, and his claim on Hachinosu all mirror his father Rocks D. Xebec's exact crew-building playbook, chapter-cited
title: Blackbeard Is Quietly Rebuilding His Father's Crew
description:
Everyone treats Blackbeard's Devil Fruit hunting as simple greed. This is the chapter-cited case that he's actually running his father Rocks D. Xebec's exact playbook: recruiting only the strongest names from Impel Down and the Warlords, hunting multiple Devil Fruits, and ruling the same island, Hachinosu, his father once conquered.

Three of Rocks' own crewmates grew up to become Emperors. This traces exactly how far Blackbeard is going to make that happen again.
comment: Is Blackbeard just greedy for power, or is he deliberately rebuilding the exact crew his father once led?
